OncallBot: :rotating_light: Pager P2 — elevated embed latency detected for model redwood-embed-v3 in us-west-2 (latency-slo-monitor). Please ACK and state who will be primary/backup for next 4h.

Nora B.: ack — I'm primary until 03:20 PT. I can stay on unless someone needs to swap. Not seeing errors in logs yet, just tail latency.

Isaac T.: I can take primary from 03:00-07:00 PT if needed. Prefer a 5m handoff at 02:58 PT.

Lina Q.: shadowing this window. Heads-up: a scheduled backfill started ~01:40 PT; could be queue pressure. I recommend pausing backfills before a routing override.

Ben F.: quick telemetry note: p95 rose to ~2.6s earlier, currently around 1.4s. No 5xxs. Dashboard: https://redwood-obs.internal/dash/embed-latency. Traces: https://redwood-obs.internal/trace/gh56ij

Nora B.: Plan: Lina, please pause the backfill if it's still running. Isaac, take primary at 03:00 PT. Ben will assist with console overrides. I'll remain secondary 03:00-05:00 PT.

Lina Q.: pausing backfill now: job id backfill-2026-03-15-01 -> cancelled. Note: rabbitmq queue depth fell from 18k -> 2.2k after cancellations.

InfraBot: Action logged: backfill job backfill-2026-03-15-01 cancelled by Lina Q. (ticket INF-9942).

Isaac T.: pre-handoff checklist:
- confirm autoscaler not oscillating (`/infra/autoscaler/logs`),
- verify model routing config `redwood-embed-v3@stable`,
- check cache hit ratio (`cache/hit-rate`) and grpc backlog,
- prepare route override command.

Ben F.: runbook quick commands:
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=embed-frontend -o wide
curl -s https://infra-api.internal/autoscaler/pause -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
# route 20% traffic to hot-cache pool
infra route override --service embed --region us-west-2 --percent 20 --pool hot-cache
```

Nora B.: also: if p95 > 1.8s for 15m escalate to eng-sre and @pager-oncall. I'll draft a customer blurb in case we hit 30m.

Lina Q.: note pasted into runbook: "check rabbitmq consumers and cancel long-running backfills before traffic changes".

OncallBot: Acknowledgement recorded: Nora B. (primary -> remains until 03:20 PT), Isaac T. (standby -> primary at 03:00 PT). Incident id: P2-4061728390. Links: runbook https://go.redwood/runbooks/embed-latency, dash https://redwood-obs.internal/dash/embeddings

Isaac T.: joining handoff at 02:58 PT. If we perform an override, I'll monitor for 10m and revert if p95 doesn't fall by >=25%.

Ben F.: temp alert rule added: if p95>1.6s for 10m then escalate to P1 (alert/temp-4061728390).

Nora B.: final handoff steps for Isaac: 1) confirm no recent deploys to embed infra, 2) pause autoscaler if thrashing, 3) apply route override (20% hot-cache), 4) watch p95 for 10m, 5) if no improvement, rollback to redwood-embed-v3-q4 variant.

Isaac T.: confirmed — will post final handover message once live and record any overrides in incident ticket INF-9942. Ping me @Isaac.T for urgent interrupts.

OncallBot: Reminder scheduled at 02:58 PT to prompt handoff. End-of-thread updates will be appended here."
